claims.claim: Reviewers report performance slowdowns or lag when using heavy or imaginative mods.

citations.review_text:
I messed around in the sandbox, but the destruction wasn't satisfying enough. The base tools are kinda unimaginative, and the more imaginative ones in the mod zone caused the game to slow down enormously. The physics is interesting and reasonably consistent, but it didn't add up to value for money (£26).
More of a tech demo than a game.

It's a great game especially when playing with mods in sandbox or with friends i recommend to wait for a discount though! and i also recommend a good pc i have a pretty good gaming laptop and it lags when using heavy mods like orbital strikes and stuff like that

claims.claim: Reviewers describe forced speedrun or timed mechanics in missions that cannot be skipped.

citations.review_text: it would be fun if I didnt get hard locked out by a timed mission I can't skip and I can't okay sandbox without it. ruined the whole fucking game because now I can't play any of it.
Might've recommended if it weren't for the stupid forced speedrun mechanic that's ruining all the fun in almost every mission.

claims.claim: Reviewers mention unchangeable Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) or screen filters that affect visual clarity.

citations.review_text: Shitty ass piss filter on the screen you can't turn off. I see the one voxel pixel in multiple different shades and they change when you look and move around.

I'm refunding Teardown on the basis of Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) that cannot be switched off. My eyesight isn't great as it is, and I'm not playing a game that makes me question it even as up-close as my monitor. I like my picture sharp, and TAA is anything but. Teardown seems like a great game, but I'm not supporting developers who screw their players up like that. It's honestly baffling why would such a voxel-based pixelated game even need AA...
Anti-aliasing must be a choice, not a chore.

citations.review_text: fun game real world physics except for massive chunks, may cause pc to lag. on a rtx5070 and ryzen 9 7900ti it runs well, lags at mass distruction sometimes even crashes my pc tho. would recommend if have a really good pc

-Amazing game. 
-Love the graphics, though it can get extremely laggy if you mess around with explosives to much or spawn too 
 many objects. 
-Favorite things to do: put tons of boosters on low cars and go high speeds, fly jets with too many boosters on 
 them that go mach 110+, abuse adjustable thruster mods to break the game.

-Second favorite mod: Tesla Roadster (Rocket package) --> flying tesla roadster, toggle infinite cold gas thrusters
-Third favorite mod: Specific Vehicle Tuner MP(AI) --> completely mod different cars power and stats
-Overall love the game and play often in free time.
-1000% reccomend
The game already has a story and sandbox that are very fun in my opinion. Though when you throw mods into the mix the game gets incredibly fun but watch out for lag.

single_points.text: One reviewer says the later missions are just awful, specifically noting a chopper flying around that magically knows where they are and is immune to weapons.

citation.review_text:
Fun game. Better with friends. It has a solid mix of janky graphics with a fun gameplay loop and a goofy story that will make you chuckle as you play through the story.

A few issues to expect- If you play co-op the progress does not count for both of you so you will have to redo everything. Not a great thing.

The later missions are just awful. Probably where I will stop playing some chopper flying around shooting me that magically knows where I am no matter what I do and its immune to the rocket launcher and guns I have? Just not fun game design for me. 

Worth playing but expect limited value.
